item.title: How to Permanently Redact Sensitive Text in PDF Files Without Cloud Uploads
item.description: Learn how true in-browser PDF redaction works, why drawing black boxes in standard editors leaks data, and how to flatten sensitive documents locally.

item.title: Why Traditional Metadata Stripping Fails: Inspecting EXIF, XMP & Document Streams
item.description: Standard file cleaners often leave hidden camera serial numbers, GPS coordinates, and revision histories intact in document binary trees. An analysis of client-side binary tree purges.

item.title: Client-Side Big Data Transformation: Processing 500MB Payloads in Browser RAM
item.description: How streaming Web Workers, Transferable ArrayBuffers, and chunked WebAssembly runtimes parse enterprise JSON/CSV datasets on the client with zero cloud computation bills.
